question: Under what condition is a gift to be given to one who was previously accomplished and tested for one year?
premises: A gift is marked as something that ought to be given.
The recipient is one who was previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for the span of one year.
inference: Only a previously accomplished person who has passed a one-year test is a fit recipient for the gift.
uncertainties: The nature of the gift itself is not specified.
plain_english: What is to be given should go to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
